name: Parcello
author: Gerald Reimertz

sections.description:
This Plugin will enable you to display shipping information to your users directly in your shop.

It will automatically sync your shipments with your parcello business account.

By using this Plugin we have to connect with the parcello business API so Plugins data will be shared with Parcello.

We know that your Data is sensible and you are always able to remove all of your Data by removing this Plugin and deletion of your Parcello account.

Feedback is greatly appreciated and we would love to hear from you via the plugin’s support and features page.
